PP_DICE.Title: Physical Play Dice
PP_DICE.EnabledHint: Enable intercepting public player rolls for manual entry of physical dice.
PP_DICE.ShowChatBadgeHint: Display a 'Physical' badge on chat cards when a roll was entered manually.
PP_DICE.AnimateDSNHint: Show Dice So Nice 3D animation landing on the physical result.
PP_DICE.ToggleHint: Keybinding to toggle physical dice interception on/off.
PP_DICE.DigitalRollHint: Press Enter (empty), Escape, 'R', or click to roll digital RNG
PP_DICE.SubmitHint: Confirm physical dice (or press Enter when empty for digital roll)
PP_DICE.DieInputHint: Enter physical roll, or leave empty and press Enter / Esc / R for digital roll
PP_DICE.KeyboardHint: Empty Enter / Esc / R = digital roll
PP_DICE.InvalidInput: Please enter a valid number for all dice.
PP_DICE.BypassedSecret: Secret roll bypassed to digital RNG.
